parsed_json.up: Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles for compounds reported in document CHEMBL1212812. Join docs, compound_records, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1212812'. Require canonical_smiles via INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
